title: IDK if my dreams are in mall world ¿
content: Whenever I dream about a mall or supermarket they look like ones in my area that I’ve visited IRL, only weirder and bigger. HOWEVER, I constantly dream about huge backrooms-esque bathrooms and waterparks with Minecraft dynamics (super deep pools I somehow don’t die in). I’m often using the toilet with no doors, which pisses me off, but my bathrooms are pretty clean and new.
